verdict.rationale: Luma publishes llms.txt files at both lumalabs.ai/llms.txt and docs.lumalabs.ai/llms.txt; a live probe returned HTTP 200 for the docs one. Every documentation page can also be fetched as markdown by appending .md, which gives agents a clean, agent-oriented view of the docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-corpus export, and no independent or community report of agents actually using these files.
